item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to force the ace of diamonds: tapped cards are kept if they include it and discarded otherwise. At the final tap, the tapped card is kept only if it is the ace of diamonds; otherwise it is discarded."}
